name: GR-2
summary: GR-2 scales video-generative pretraining to tens of millions of internet clips before robot fine-tuning, and adds a trajectory-conditioned video-prediction stage that effectively plans in pixel space before acting. Reported results span more than 100 tasks with strong multi-task and unseen-scene success rates.
innovation: Internet-scale video generative pretraining directly serving a manipulation policy.
Predict the video of the task first, then derive the actions that realize it.
matters: Bridges video generation and control, the idea now central to world-model robotics.
lineage: GR-1 scaled up with generative video planning added.
